implementation.originalPlan: quote returns exactly observedUserSendPlanVersion:1, subject and quote. subject is the existing observed initial subject; quote is the unchanged existing UserSend quote contract. All are detached and frozen DATA, not signing/operation authority.
implementation.laterStages: Rebind the ORIGINAL subject to the independently supplied selected intent, decode each supplied raw account result using that selected payer/chain, and require identical previous hash and next height. Reuse existing work/assembly/complete key-work-hash-price consumers with the ORIGINAL quote and acknowledgement.
implementation.priceMovement: Fresh supplied price observations may advance within the ORIGINAL policy horizon. Never derive the original acknowledgement from their new frontier. No quote/pair refresh or block repair is performed.
implementation.planSemantics: Stateless, portable, reproducible DATA; reconstructing or reusing this plan is not one-use/consumed authority or durable custody. Requoting can describe a new DATA plan, never permission to replace/re-sign or refresh originals after signing elsewhere. Declared UNSIGNED is not signer-state proof.
implementation.projection: Account-frontier decoder checks the bounded supported shape and projected payer/chain/height/hash only. Other previous-block fields are NOT complete block/hash/signature/confirmation validation, authentication, ancestry or current account/funds evidence.
implementation.noEffects: No RPC/native owner/endpoint, SDK/current-state preparation or real PREPARE, work search, key generation, signing, publication, retry, recovery, provider setup or active buyer cutover. ZenonTransactionPlanner.prepareUnsigned() remains a stub; locked SDK105 path is unchanged.
